The Other Ones were a pop rock band which formed in Berlin in 1984.

Australian-born siblings Alf Klimek (lead vocals), the twins Jayney Klimek (lead vocals) and Johnny Klimek (bass guitar) were joined by a German-born trio of Stephan Gottwald (keyboards), Andreas Schwarz-Ruszczynski (guitars) and Uwe Hoffmann (drums).
They issued two albums, The Other Ones (1986) and Learning to Walk (1988), before disbanding in 1990.
